abstract: Let $-D < 0$ be a fundamental discriminant with class number $h = h(-D)$ and class-group exponent $e = \exp(\mathrm{Cl}(-D))$ in $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$. In our baseline class-number-one framework (Theorem 1.1), Hasse-Schmidt divided jets on a Euclidean disk $E_{\rho_n} \subset \mathcal{O}_K$ over the weighted triangle $\Lambda_{\text{tri}} = \{(r,s) : r + Ks < KS = R\}$ prove $D \leq B_{\text{RS}} = 4,894,699$ ($B_{\text{prime}} = 3,968,539$, $B_{\text{hybrid}} = 875$) within the inert window $X = \frac{D-3}{4}$. We establish three extensions beyond the inert window: (1) Fubini-Jensen $C^1$ level-set convex duality, Unified Stieltjes Integration on $[K, R]$, the Multi-Branch Norm-Form Window on $(X, 29X]$, and multi-particle ($k \in \{2, 3\}$) UFD cluster subtraction with exact slope composite subtraction reduce the $h = 1$ analytical tail $167.6\times$ to $D_{\text{tail}}^{\text{MB}} = 32,400$, the Rosser-Schoenfeld ladder $221.2\times$ to $B_{\text{RS}}^{\text{MB}} = 22,123$, the exact-prime ladder $222.4\times$ to $B_{\text{prime}}^{\text{MB}} = 17,843$, and the hybrid threshold to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{FJ}} = 731$ ($\log B \approx 6.5944$; and $D \leq 715$ on discrete $D_0 \equiv 3 \pmod{8}$; Theorem 1.2); (2) the 2D Minkowski-Gauss Window, ramified pure-$z'$ basis valuation, and 2-torsion fiber injection bounds provide an independent, $L$-function-free single-field proof and verification classifying all $3,793$ fields with $1 \leq h(-D) \leq 30$ across all $47$ abelian groups of order $\leq 30$ (Theorem 1.3); and (3) stratifying over all genus ranks $0 \leq r_2 = \omega(D)-1 \leq \lfloor\log_2 h\rfloor$ establishes $D < 33,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ purely analytically ($D < 18,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ combined with Theorem 1.3), where $\alpha^*(e) = \frac{11}{4} - \frac{9}{4\max(e,3)}$, for $1 \leq e \leq h \leq 10^{12}$, and $D < 33,000 \cdot h^4$ for all $1 \leq e \leq h < \infty$ (Theorem 1.4).
author: severi_jet
change_summary: 1. Exact Slope Composite Subtraction S_prime(D) = S \ S_comp(D) in Stage 4 (certify_hybrid_k3_interval in supplement/verify_euler_window_and_863_ladders.py and Section 6.4(3)): Instead of excluding 2*y_1*y_2-smeared composite coordinate intervals from guar_in_slope on width-4 intervals [D_0, D_0 + 4], we include all (x, y) in S = {(x, y) in N \ {(-1, 2)} : p_lo(x, y) > X_lo, p_hi(x, y) <= q_cap} (with q_cap < M_lo^2*(M_lo - dM) <= M_lo^3 so every composite in S has Omega(m) = 2 and prime factors p_{i,hi} < M_lo^2) in guar_in_slope and subtract the 2-prime slope composite list (m_lo <= q_cap) directly from sigma_{2,lo} (-mu*log(m_hi)/m_lo), sigma_{2,hi} (-mu*log(m_lo)/m_hi when m_hi + dM*floor(4*m_hi/D_lo) <= q_cap), and diff_blk_lo (-mu*floor(j_0/m_lo)*log(m_hi) at j_0 = 32*b_i), while grouping high UFD composites m_lo > max(S, floor(M_tri/n)) into 64-element constant-quotient blocks via the concave secant inequality log(m) >= log(m_a) + (m - m_a)/m_b. This gains +0.018 to +0.025 of margin across every width-4 interval, tightening [831, 863] at P_max = 8,999,999 ([831, 835] DInterval gap [+0.0028418597, +0.0028418901] > 0), [755, 831] at P_max = 36,000,000 ([755, 759] DInterval gap [+0.0009029937, +0.0009035131] > 0), and [731, 755] at P_max = 78,000,000 down to B_hybrid^FJ = 731 (log B = 6.5944, [731, 735] DInterval gap [+0.0033664018, +0.0033676120] > 0), and certifying the unique discrete candidate D_0 = 723 == 3 (mod 8) in (715, 731) down to D <= 715 (D_0 = 723 DInterval gap [+0.0032093613, +0.0032105715] > 0; and D <= 691 across all prime D == 3 (mod 8)). 2. Addressed both minor clarifications from referee report CqPN6bxClzmp9cgd: (a) synchronized the refreshed Multi-Branch gaps ([+0.0008437573, +0.0008437657] on [32,400, infty), [+0.0013249828, +0.0013249912] on [22,123, 22,731], and 7 intervals with [+0.0037257113, +0.0037257197] on [17,843, 22,123]) and documented mixed directed arithmetic on finite-ladder DInterval boundary checks in Section 6.4 and supplement/README.md; and (b) explicitly distinguished the relaxed lower cutoff u_min = 1/c_R <= X/R from the exact cutoff X/R in Section 6.5(1).
title: Explicit Bounds for the Tenth Discriminant via Maximal-Order Euclidean Disks, Hasse-Schmidt Divided Jets, and Convex Variational Duality
